# Partial unfolding with residuals and resumption at reached positions

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`residual-continuation-correspondence` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F22 · [record](residual-continuation-correspondence.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Carrying out a recipe part of the way leaves a recipe remaining where the course stands: resuming it completes the recipe, and carrying the recipe to the end is a partial course leaving nothing. Moves inserted before resuming join into one course, and can disable what remains.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For any frame and recipe (nothing, a move, a test where the course stands, one recipe after another, or a choice of two), one advance takes a move, passes a test, drops a finished first part, advances a sequence's first part or takes one side of a choice. Carrying a recipe out part of the way, a course of advances, leaves a recipe remaining at a configuration, and is a course of the frame's own moves. (`Becoming.Recipe.Advance`, `Becoming.Recipe.unfolding`, `Becoming.Recipe.Leaves`, `Becoming.Recipe.Leaves.trace`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Resuming what remains from where a partial course stands completes the recipe, and a recipe leads from s to t exactly where carrying it out from s can leave nothing remaining at t. (`Becoming.Recipe.Leaves.resume`, `Becoming.Recipe.leads_iff_leaves`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. A partial course, moves of the frame inserted from where it stands, and a resumption of what remains from where those moves led join into one course of the frame through their actual boundaries; the inserted moves are not thereby part of the recipe. (`Becoming.Recipe.Leaves.inserted`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. A partial course from a configuration is matched from any alike configuration of another frame, leaving the same recipe and ending alike, with no premise; from a configuration passing the same branching tests it is matched, ending where the same tests pass, given excluded middle as a hypothesis and the outcomes of the second frame's moves listed. (`Becoming.Recipe.Leaves.alike`, `Becoming.Recipe.Leaves.same_of_em`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Configurations passing the same branching tests answer every recipe question alike: a recipe leads from one to where a test holds exactly where it does from the other, with no premise and no finiteness. (`Becoming.SameBranchingTests.leads_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. A description of what remains together with where the course stands, exact for resumption (equal codes resume to the same tests), gives different codes to two such configurations that resume differently. (`Becoming.Recipe.Resumes`, `Becoming.Recipe.Resumes.codes_apart`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
7. In Midway, from safe, the recipe that begins and then finishes where finishing can be taken reaches done, while the recipe testing at the start whether finishing can be taken does not. (`Becoming.Midway.adaptive`, `Becoming.Midway.earlyCheck`, `Becoming.Midway.testing_before_formation_changes_results`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
8. In Midway, carrying out the choice of begin then finish, or begin alone, from safe can stand at ready with finish remaining or with nothing remaining; with finish remaining the course can reach where finish cannot be taken, with nothing remaining it cannot, so every description exact for resumption codes the two apart. (`Becoming.Midway.pending`, `Becoming.Midway.same_start_distinct_remainders`, `Becoming.Midway.remainder_changes_continuation`, `Becoming.Midway.remainder_codes_apart`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
9. In Midway, finish inserted at ready reaches done, from where the finish still remaining cannot be taken, so an inserted move can disable what remains; ready and done do not pass the same branching tests. (`Becoming.Midway.inserted_can_disable_resumption`, `Becoming.Midway.inserted_changes_tests`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
10. The earlier witnesses on the periphery's granularity unfolding: testing before formation changes the result; one start leaves the residuals finish and nothing at one reached position, and every exact presentation of the paused answers codes them apart; and an inserted finish can disable the pending finish. (`Generative.ExplanatoryResumptionCases.testing_before_formation_changes_results`, `Generative.ExplanatoryResumptionCases.same_start_reaches_distinct_residuals`, `Generative.ExplanatoryResumptionCases.exact_paused_accounts_retain_remaining_program`, `Generative.ExplanatoryResumptionCases.inserted_activity_can_disable_resumption`)
    - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* not measured: none of its declarations is in the spine run the measure reads.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Recipes are finite (moves, tests, sequences and choices), carried out by the supplied advance semantics; a partial course is a finite course of advances. Tests are branching tests of the frame, not physical operations shown to be available.
- Matching partial courses takes one recipe on both sides and alike starts, or, with excluded middle as a hypothesis and listed outcomes, starts passing all the same branching tests, stronger than agreement at block boundaries; resumption after inserted moves starts where those moves actually led.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Translation of what remains between recipes of different internal syntax is not shown: matched courses carry out one recipe on both sides.
- How a formation actually comes to remember or sense what remains is not modelled.
- Recipes have no iteration, so unbounded iteration is not covered.
- Concurrent activity and its admission are not modelled: inserted moves are a course of the same frame.
- No uniqueness of a description of what remains is shown.
- Configurations equal in the frame can differ in what remains; this implies no variable of reality independent of the one unfolding. Witness: `Becoming.Midway.same_start_distinct_remainders`.
- **Counterexample:** One start and native reached position admit different residuals; the same inserted finish activity can disable a pending finish while preserving the preceding history. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryResumptionCases.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise is used. The core declarations use no Lean axiom; the periphery declarations cited use only Lean's standard axioms (propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice), as their receipts report.

### Correspondence

<a id="history--沿革"></a>
### History

- 2026-10-09: continued the existing joining study; all new mathematical claims, counterexamples and repair conditions actually checked in Lean.
- 15 October 2026, integration I3b (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (what remains, in Becoming.Granularity). Carrying out a recipe part of the way leaves a recipe remaining where the course stands (Recipe.Leaves), and this bookkeeping is an unfolding of its own that adds no move (Recipe.Leaves.trace); resuming what remains completes the recipe, and carrying it out to the end is a partial course leaving nothing (Recipe.Leaves.resume, Recipe.leads_iff_leaves). Partial courses from alike configurations match, keeping what remains, with no premise (Recipe.Leaves.alike); from configurations passing the same tests they need listed outcomes and em (Recipe.Leaves.same_of_em). Inserted moves join a partial course and its resumption into one course without being part of the recipe (Recipe.Leaves.inserted). The witness Midway: testing where the course has arrived and testing at the start give different results; one start leaves different remainders at one configuration, which every description exact for resumption keeps apart; an inserted move can disable what remains (Midway.testing_before_formation_changes_results, Midway.remainder_codes_apart, Midway.inserted_can_disable_resumption). The periphery’s ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary.unfolding is defined by a match with an overlapping wildcard case and compiles through propext, so the witnesses of ExplanatoryResumptionCases are restated on the core’s Midway frame (the same six configurations, three moves and six steps). In the bridge, the periphery’s advances and the core’s correspond one to one (Recipe.advance_ofProgram, Recipe.Advance.toProgram), and a cut is a partial course leaving the same program (cut_iff_leaves); cut_resume, execution_iff_completed_cut and resumption_after_inserted_history hold as stated, partial_history_matches with em; same_preserves_resumption needs no premise (the periphery reads each continuation question as one test, classically; the core as finitely many). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope.
